title: February 2011 Christchurch earthquake
summary: A Mw 6.1 (GCMT) earthquake struck near Christchurch, New Zealand, with an ISC origin time of 21 February 2011 UTC; the police call it the 22 February earthquake. As at 9 February 2012 the official toll was 185 victims, 115 of them in the Canterbury Television building.

as_recorded.value: the official earthquake toll was 185 victims

importance.justification: A deadly, damaging national-scale disaster in New Zealand that drove extensive earthquake research.

audience_note: Mentions deaths from a disaster, including many victims.

sources.title: List of deceased | New Zealand Police

reviewer_note: The ISC origin time is 21 February 23:51 UTC, which is 22 February local time; the sources do not state the local conversion explicitly. Magnitude is given as Mw(GCMT) 6.1 in the ISC listing, while a cited paper title says Mw 6.2. Local date relies on the police wording '22 February earthquake'.} (Drafted by the Wikipedia pipeline from isc.ac.uk, police.govt.nz; quotes machine-checked.)
